hypothesis: H79-XCR: expert faults missing from the QFDB/INGENIOUS catalogue concentrate where amplitude-balanced potential-field edges and catalogue-tip geometry indicate structure with weak surface expression; a label-blind surface fitted to those channels should transfer to a fault population compiled by a different campaign (SGMC), and the competition metric should be exploited by exact marginal-DTI emission rather than a hand-set dot budget.
mechanism: 14 label-blind channels from training_features.tif (tilt derivative, multi-scale horizontal gradients of RTP and isostatic gravity, depth-to-basement gradient, conductivity edge, detrended-elevation step/relief, seismicity, strain invariant, TMI vertical gradient, gravity slope) plus 4 channels derived only from the visible catalogue mask; out-of-fold component-masked HistGradientBoosting regression of the 300 m kernel-credit target; emission by gems57.emit.greedy_allocate (exact two-sided marginal test) and by fixed-budget 3 px NMS placement.
named_non_fault_mimic: Playa and lake-margin shorelines (Lahontan/Bonneville) and fluvial terrace risers give the same amplitude-balanced gravity/magnetic edges and the same detrended-elevation steps; Quaternary basalt flows give magnetic edges with no fault; linear cultural features (TIGER roads) also register in the elevation-step channel.

I1.name: QFDB/INGENIOUS catalogue hide-and-recover
I1.split: buffered-whole-components-loqo-v2, 4 folds, 3 px feature collar, 12 px boundary erosion

I2.name: SGMC off-catalogue recovery (external proxy)
I2.truth_definition: SGMC fault pixels more than 3 px from the competition catalogue
I2.note: SGMC is never a model feature. It is a second mapping campaign, so recovering its off-catalogue pixels is a domain-matched proxy for the competition's new-fault population. It is not an organizer score.

shipped_artifact.exterior: NaN outside footprint, nodata=NaN (official R6 convention)

leakage_canary.result: PASS (maximum symmetric AUC < 0.90 on both instruments; largest single-feature values were dens_visible_40 0.791 on I1 and det_elev_relief_s5 0.793 on I2)
leakage_canary.key_measurement: on I2 the catalogue-proximity channels are uninformative (dens_visible_40 AUC 0.47-0.55, log1p_d_visible 0.43-0.53) while terrain channels reach 0.75-0.79; on I1 the ordering reverses (dens_visible_40 0.72-0.79). The two instruments rank the feature families oppositely.

registry_novelty.reading: DUPLICATE. 18 sparse registry dot fields already contain more than 70% of this candidate's dots within 3 px. Any surface dominated by catalogue corridor density reproduces the family's emission shape, because every archived lane is built on the same distance-to-catalogue signal.

validator_output.official_rules: R1 PASS, R2 PASS, R3 PASS, R4 PASS, R5 PASS, R6 PASS (7,111,787 NaN cells outside the footprint, 0 non-NaN), R7 PASS (0 NaN/inf inside), R8 PASS (min 0.0, max 1.0 inside)
validator_output.note: This is the first artifact in this repository that satisfies R1-R8 including the official NaN-exterior rule, because the shared writer was corrected (IR-79-232). A format PASS is not organizer acceptance.

reason_not_submittable: Three independent automated gates fail: (1) the candidate is a registry duplicate under the like-for-like reading (18 firings; max dot-field overlap 1.0); (2) its HOLDOUT-DTI is below the canonical incumbent on both seeds; (3) it therefore could not honestly be promoted. Format compliance is real but is not scientific validity.
deliverables: A format-compliant, byte-unique GeoTIFF with an unambiguous DO NOT SUBMIT filename
A shared-code fix that removes the format dead end for every future lane (IR-79-232)

A second validation instrument (SGMC off-catalogue) that localizes why the whole family is stuck: catalogue-proximity features do not transfer to the competition's target population and are the direct cause of the duplication
A preregistered, fully automated decision with no human inspector in the loop
next_research_priority: A lane whose surface contains no distance-to-catalogue term at all, validated primarily on I2 (SGMC off-catalogue) rather than I1, and whose emission budget is set by the calibrated marginal-DTI rule. The two-instrument split measured here is the evidence base for that decision.
